ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark black) pixels covering >95% of the visible surface area, with extreme high-intensity (white) localized pixels confined to the distal tips and a singular central linear mark.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity dark field; high-contrast white clusters localized at the far distal tips of both the left and right lobes; a distinct, isolated horizontal white linear blob is mapped to the mid-axial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending ~10% of the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels across the entire trailing edge; specific large-scale rectangular-shaped notch visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve following the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips; convex anterior curve leading to pointed distal termini.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels (likely barnacle colonization) aggregated on the distal 5% of the left fluke tip and right fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, isolated horizontal high-intensity linear mark approximately mid-fluke on the right lobe, oriented parallel to the longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the median notch; clustered white scarring at the distal extremities.
